entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely useless to me.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your order number or the email address associated with your account?
The order is VF-8675309. This is absolutely ridiculous. The sizing chart is a complete lie. This thing is way too tight, I can barely breathe in it.

Okay, I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Pro-Cycle Jersey, delivered on October 2nd. I understand your frustration with the fit. What specifically is the issue? Are you saying it's the wrong size and you'd like to try another, or do you just want to return it?

I just told you, it's the wrong size! Do you people even listen? I don't want an exchange, this has been a terrible experience. I want my money back. Now. If this isn't sorted out in the next two minutes, I want your manager, and I'm posting a review about this on every website I can find.
I assure you, there's no need for that, sir. I can definitely handle this for you. Let me just confirm the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Unbelievable. Confirming? Just process the return. It's not rocket science.

Okay, I've reviewed your order and our policy. It looks like the jersey was delivered 79 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it? No more games?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return process. I am sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you now. Just package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Alright then. Just make sure that email actually shows up.
It has just been sent. You should see it within the next few minutes. Again, my apologies that the jersey was too tight and didn't work out. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
